svg.title: delta-frontier
svg.desc: Four 2026 refinements of the delta rule, each shown as a toy 5×5 state with the part it gates. FG²-GDN: per-channel write strength β on key and value (tied; separate in FG²-GDN+). Gated DeltaNet-2: an erase gate b per key channel and a write gate w per value channel, both at address k. Kalman DeltaNet: step size from an uncertainty state p per key channel. Erase-then-Delta: a separate erase address e before the write at k. Timeline: RWKV-7 already had per-channel write strength in March 2025.
